out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THE THREE-VAT SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 103F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC INFORMED MAINTENANCE DURING INSPECTION THAT THE THREE-VAT SINK NEEDS TO MEET 110F. PLEASE PROVIDE EHS WITH PROOF THE SINK CAN MEET 110F AT A MINIMUM AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM WAS UNABLE TO PROVIDE COPY OF CERTIFICATION DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PIC WILL SHARE CERTIFICATION WITH EHS AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. PLEASE ENSURE CERTIFICATION IS SHARED WITH THE EHS BY THE 2ND OF JUNE.
